name: Web 3 Dollar
oneLiner: USD3 is a Reserve Protocol RToken/DTF backed by yield-bearing USDC and USDS wrappers (Aave, Compound, Steakhouse, Sky savings), governed by RSR stakers.
collateral: Reserve Protocol DTF basket made up of Savings USDS, Aave USDC, wrapped Compound USDCv3, and Steakhouse USDC strategy exposure
pegMechanism: Reserve RToken/DTF whose holders can redeem into the backing basket subject to Reserve protocol throttles and basket mechanics; RSR stakers govern and absorb losses

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USD3 is a redeemable Reserve Protocol basket token backed by dollar-stablecoin and lending-vault positions with RSR first-loss capital. The current public disclosures identify the basket, Reserve governance, and redemption design but do not expose the v9 overlay's measured assurance-and-reconciliation, claim-and-segregation, or custody-continuity metrics; those mechanism components remain a methodology-capability blocker and are not inferred from the archetype classification.

listingStatusReview.reason: NAV-accreting Reserve Protocol DeFi yield-vault basket DTF appreciating above $1, not a fixed-par stablecoin; no active stablecoin links it as reserve backing (listing policy 2.0).
